question: How does the current e2e implementation define the detector timeline and the train/val/test split, and how does that differ from the V2 raw-telemetry timeline?

current_e2e_implementation.derivation: boundaries computed from the GT event registry span: absolute_start = min(GT start) = 1625108812249 (2021-07-01 11:06:52.249 CST), absolute_end = max(GT end) = 1627747192313; b1 = start + 3/5 span = 1626691840287 (2021-07-19 18:50:40 CST), b2 = start + 4/5 span = 1627219516300 (2021-07-25 21:25:16 CST)
evidence: artifacts/p5/g0r2/split_feasibility.json (start_min_ms/end_max_ms equal GT registry min/max; mode duration_60_20_20)
problems_under_v2: split depends on GT taxonomy (min/max of GT events): changing GT inclusion rules would move Train/Test boundaries (violates V2 s12)
three-way 60/20/20 with an official Validation split (V2 mandates two-way 70/30, no validation)
train share is 60% of the GT span, not 70% of the telemetry timeline

v2_recommended_timeline.primary_caliber: metric_only (matches Ada-MGAD main pre_GAIA.py: 30s grid built from aligned metric timestamps)

numeric_differences.grid_start: current grid starts 1625108820000 vs metric_only 1625133600000: current is 826 bins (~6h53m) EARLIER; that early segment (07-01 11:07-18:00 CST) contains zero metric samples, so metric features there are NaN->ffill->0 fabrications; vs union caliber current starts 140 bins later
numeric_differences.train_boundary: V2 metric_only 70% split (07-22 22:12 CST) is 3.14 days LATER than current b1 (07-19 18:50) and 2.97 days EARLIER than current b2 (07-25 21:25)
numeric_differences.train_share: current train = 60% of GT span; V2 = 70.000% of telemetry bins
numeric_differences.robustness: V2 boundary is invariant to GT taxonomy changes and to the N=87121 endpoint variant (split_unchanged=true)

events_before_metric_timeline_start.implication: under the metric_only timeline these events have no metric-based AD bins; they must be reported as timeline-excluded (logs/traces exist for them). The union caliber would keep them at the cost of ~8h of metric-less bins at the head of Train.

consequences_for_gt_events.all_12_cpu_anomalies_under_current_split: fall entirely inside the current Test segment (split_manifest.json); registry-verified cpu window is 2021-07-27 23:46 -> 2021-07-31 20:00 CST, so all 12 also land in Test under the V2 boundary (07-22 22:12) - drift fact remains, must be reported, split must NOT be moved to balance it (V2 s13)
